outcome: Correlation between neonatal weight, PR, RR and CrSO₂
cohort: 84 full-term newborn infants delivered by cesarean section
finding: This study found a correlation between CrSO₂ and SpO₂ and CrSO₂ and EtCO₂ during birth transition of full-term infants delivered by elective cesarean section, but CrSO₂ had no significant correlation with neonatal weight, PR, or RR.
